phases.name: Foundation & Setup
tasks: Install Core Libs: PixiJS, Pinia, Vue Router, @vueuse/core

phases.name: Editor Layout System
tasks: Implement Base Panels: Scene, Hierarchy, Inspector, Assets, Console

phases.name: Interaction & History System (Critical)
phases.description: Robust Undo/Redo, Clipboard, and Gizmo interaction.
tasks: Add History panel to Layout in AppHeader
HistoryPanel doesn't need to be in Layout at app start in DockView, it can be opened from the menu.
Ensure Global Keyboard Shortcuts (Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, Delete)
Add functionality of ClipboardManager in AppHeader Edit menu
Fix Gizmo Scaling (Negative Scales/Flipping & Center Scaling)

phases.name: Editor Debug System 2.0
phases.description: Centralized control for all visual debugging tools.
tasks: Implement Physics Body Visualization (Velocity Vectors, Centers)
Create Debug Toolbar (Toggle Visibility of each layer)

phases.name: Visual Tools & Entity UX
phases.description: Improving how we visualize and interact with invisible logic.
tasks: Implement Editor-Only Visuals for Empty Entities (Icons/Gizmos)
Decouple Sprite Component from default 'Create Entity'
Refactor Gizmo Bounds for Component-less Entities

phases.name: Project Architecture & Core Gameplay
tasks: Implement Input Manager Editor (Map Keys to Actions) - DONE
Implement Audio Manager Editor (Channels, Buses) - DONE
Implement Physics Settings (Gravity, Layers/Masks Matrix) - DONE
Implement Runtime InputSystem (Map Settings to API) - DONE
Implement Runtime Audio Mixer (Buses/Channels Volume Control) - DONE
Implement Runtime Scene Loading API (loadSceneByPath) - DONE
Implement Global Game State (Persistence between scenes) - DONE

phases.name: Asset Pipeline 2.0
tasks: Implement `ProjectManager` to load/save `project.json` (Single Source of Truth)
Refactor `AssetDatabase` to hydrate from Manifest (Instant Load, No Scan)
Implement Import Workflow (Copy to assets -> Update Manifest)
Optimize Watcher (Only detect external intrusions, no valid-flow flood)
Implement Context Menu 'Edit in external editor' (Placeholder for non-folders)
Implement Multi-selection Logic (Shift + Click, Drag Rect)
Update Context Menu actions to support Multi-Selection (Batch Delete, Batch Rename?)

phases.name: Inspector Overhaul (Live Mode)
phases.description: Make the editor feel alive and reactive.
tasks: Implement 'Live Mode' for Inspectors (Poll values if Game Running)
Add Script Parameter Parsing (AST based properties in Inspector)
Standardize all Inspectors to emit Commands (Undoable)
Refactor Color Pickers and Input Fields for UX
Implement Entity Sorting & Renaming in Hierarchy

phases.name: Physics Engine Implementation
phases.description: Full integration of Matter.js with ECS and Runtime.
tasks: Integrate Matter.js World into Engine Loop
Implement Collision Events (onCollisionStart, onCollisionEnd) in Scripting

phases.name: Tilemap System 2.0
tasks: Design Tilemap Data Structure (Layers, Chunks, sparse arrays)
Implement Brush/Bucket/Eraser Tools in Scene View
Integrate Tilemaps with Physics (Composite Bodies for optimization)
